letterPrompts.text: Напиши письмо в управляющую компанию: в вашем доме неделю нет горячей воды. Опиши проблему, что уже делали, и что просишь.
Напиши письмо руководителю: ты хочешь взять неделю отпуска вне графика. Объясни причину и предложи, как закрыть задачи.
Напиши другу: ты приглашаешь его на свой день рождения. Дай детали, предложи варианты, как добраться.
Напиши в магазин: товар пришёл с дефектом. Опиши, чего ждёшь (замена/возврат).
Напиши соседу: музыка по вечерам мешает. Вежливо попроси решить вопрос.
Напиши другу из другой страны: расскажи о недавней поездке и предложи встретиться.

writingPrompts.text: Some people believe that children should start learning a foreign language at primary school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people think governments should spend money on public transport, while others think roads should be improved. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
More people now work from home. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
In many cities, traffic congestion is a growing problem. What are the causes, and what measures could be taken to reduce it?
Some argue that university education should be free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many people spend a large part of their free time on social media. Why is this? Is it a positive or negative development?
Some people prefer to buy products made in their own country; others prefer imported goods. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Obesity is increasing in many countries. What are the reasons, and what can individuals and governments do about it?
Technology makes people less creative. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Tourism brings money to many regions but may damage local culture and the environment. Do the benefits outweigh the drawbacks?
Fewer people read books nowadays. What are the reasons for this, and is it a problem?
It is better for a country to have a few large cities than many small towns. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
